title: Avocado Cream for Oily Skin: How to Use It Without the Shine
ex: Oily skin still needs moisture. Here is how to use avocado cream in a thin layer, with amounts for Indian summer, monsoon and winter.
rt: Avocado Cream for Oily Skin: How Much and When | Mirc Glow
rd: Can you use avocado cream for oily skin? Yes, in a thin layer. Learn how much to use, night vs day, and simple season-by-season tips for Indian weather.
quick: Yes, oily skin can use avocado cream. Use about half a pea-sized amount at night, start on the cheeks and spread only a thin leftover layer on the T-zone. In the day, many people with oily skin just use sunscreen, which is essential with kojic acid.
facts: Oily skin can still be short of water
Half a pea-sized amount is enough at night
Apply on cheeks first, T-zone last
Daily SPF 30+ is a must with kojic acid
